title: Persistent Work conversation under GitHub event trigger
objective: Determine whether a GitHub event-triggered task created from one ChatGPT Work conversation returns its result to that exact Work conversation or creates a separate task-associated conversation.
success_criteria: The event-triggered task is created from one identifiable Work conversation.
The orchestrator posts the exact trigger probe to PR #1 after the task is armed.
The event-triggered task runs without manual user prompting.
The task result appears in the exact same Work conversation that created the task.
No separate task/result conversation is created for the trigger response.
partial_success: Event trigger fires but result appears in a separate task-associated conversation.
failure_conditions: Work is not available on the account.
GitHub event-triggered tasks are not available despite Work access.
The configured GitHub trigger does not fire.
The trigger result cannot be traced to a conversation.

safety.allowed_external_write: one non-@cursor PR comment containing only the trigger nonce

human_step_required: Create or open a cloud Work conversation and create the GitHub event-triggered task from that exact conversation using the prepared prompt.
why_human_step_is_required: The current Chat conversation cannot switch itself into the user's Work UI or bind an event-triggered task to a specific Work conversation.
